lines.text: Mountains, plateaus, plains and valleys are the natural features that make up the Earth's
surface. These natural features are termed as landforms and they have different shapes and
profiles.
There are two types of Geomorphic processes. One develops many patterns and landscapes and
the other changes these landscapes.
Diastrophism, volcanoes, folding and faulting etc., originate in the interior of the Earth and
create mountain ranges, oceanic ridges, trenches and rift valleys .
Whereas other set of Earth processes continuously evolve surface of the Earth. These are
weathering, erosion, and mass movement. In this chapter we will study: types of mountains,
plains and plateaus along with a brief introduction of their formation.
1Mountains
, mountain is natural elevation of the Earth's surface which rises at least 600 meters above sea
level and at least 50% of its surface consists of steep slopes. While hills are natural elevations of
Earth's surface which resemble mountains in many ways but are of ower elevation.Both are
conical-shaped,existingsinglyoringroups.
We know that the majority of Earthquakes and volcanoes are caused by the movement of
tectonic plates. It is interesting to know that mountains have been formed by the same
processes as well.There are three major types of mountains.
